checks.requirement: RT diagnostics: every RT case of negative-cases.json, sent as written, gives exactly its expected code, status, pointer, cause, allowed form and span located in the raw request body: RT01 to RT06 with the amendment 006 texts, RT07 unchanged.
check_python_controls.py passes for every negative case of negative-cases.json.

Python against the baseline: every typed prompt of the 127 public products (public-products-003b) and the 544 legacy jobs (legacy544 run-005), sent without target and with target python, gives a compile response equal byte for byte to the baseline's response, and assembling that bundle gives response bytes equal to the baseline's.

Python recordings: python_unchanged with its amendment_004 rule, python_replay.py --asset-break over public-products-003b and legacy544 run-005, passes with no failure; validate_cases.py gives the frozen Python file hashes.

Rust compile against the baseline: every case of the rust-output-055 run-003 inventory (the accepted run of rust-output-acceptance-2026-10-20-phase2.json), compiled with target rust, gives a response equal to the baseline's response for the same request except bundle.assets.backend, bundle.assets.target_contract and bundle.hashes.payload_sha256; RS12 and RS13 give the baseline's compiler-v1 refusal bytes.

check_rust_unchanged.py: every phase 1 and phase 2 Rust product of rust-output-055 run-003 assembles to byte-identical files on the candidate; phase 1 compares a check_rust_products.py --no-gates report made on the candidate.

Rust bundles of the baseline: every Rust bundle the baseline returns for that inventory is refused by the candidate at assemble with ASSET_HASH_MISMATCH, and the same bundle rebased on the candidate's backend and target_contract descriptors assembles to the files_sha256 run-003 recorded.
check_rust_products.py with --refusals phase2 passes assemble_refusals, with A6_amendment_004; A4 (target python in a Rust bundle) keeps INVALID_SCHEMA at /bundle/target.
check_cli.py passes, and a case added with react-output-v1 phase 1 shows that `som compile --target react` forwards the string unchanged.
An independent audit, written from this plan and the raw outputs only, reports no failure and nothing unrun.
